thermo_counters.trhoStateEvaluations: Calls to public Cantera TD branch validation, includes rejected calls
thermo_counters.densityRootChecks: Explicit densityCalc inverse root checks inside setTRho; implicit roots inside full phase TP evaluations are counted by fullPhaseEvaluations
thermo_counters.fullPhaseEvaluations: Entries to phaseProperties, including rejected calls; not all Cantera internal work
thermo_counters.energyCvEvaluations: Minimal e/cv/p probe calls (fast or same-EOS public fallback)
thermo_counters.selectedMuEvaluations: Explicit chemical-potential requests in phaseProperties and selected real-fluid API; excludes internal Cantera requests
thermo_counters.partialHEvaluations: Selected real-fluid partial enthalpy requests; not all kinetic internal work
thermo_counters.flashCandidates: activeFlash candidate starts; not scalar/no-gas candidate calls
thermo_counters.sourceDirectionProbes: Invoked directional closure OR source probe samples; includes h and h/2, both feasible directions
thermo_counters.FzFactorizations: Cached small tangent LU builds, excludes Woodbury K factors
thermo_counters.RzBuilds: Completed Ns by m source linearization builds
thermo_counters.nasaCoefficientVisits: Nonzero-composition species coefficient contributions when rebuilding a NASA region aggregate
thermo_counters.branchCertificates: Per-probe exact admissible-root certificates, not global phase stability
thermo_counters.woodburyFactors: Successful small K factors; kinetic core is S=0
thermo_counters.sourceAttempts/sourceAccepted/sourceFail: Individual C source calls, including worker calls; whole Flow accepted/rejected attempts logged separately
thermo_counters.diagnosticJvCalls: Public Jv diagnostic calls, separate from actual matrixFreeProducts

profile_aggregation.legacy_sparse_nonzeros: sum of last worker snapshots, NOT temporal peak
profile_aggregation.legacy_timing_factorNonzeros: sum of last worker snapshots, NOT temporal peak
profile_aggregation.legacy_timing_seconds: sum and per-metric max logged; original sparse-profile scope retained
profile_aggregation.jobSeconds: sum elapsed worker job durations including failures; NOT batch wall time or process CPU seconds
profile_aggregation.prototype/workers/combined: combined = prototype + workers once; never add all three
profile_aggregation.resets: v21 costs never reset; legacy reset APIs retained, only quiescent external use, no campaign resets

transport.layoutTiles/layoutLaunches: Submitted pack/unpack tiles including immutable fixed initialization
transport.memcpyCalls: H2D+D2H+D2D submissions, includes initialization and diagnostics
transport.payloadBytes: H2D+D2H+D2D bytes; profiling query reads are charged on the next snapshot
transport.nasaValidationEvaluations: Actually evaluated cached-mode h values for cells with gas; recompute=0
transport.nasaFaceEvaluations: Actual interior face h calls with detailedGasCounters enabled; zero when instrumentation disabled, NOT proof of no work
transport.temperatureBasisBuilds: Built cell temperature bases; NASA9 log/inv and powers reused
transport.detailedGasCounters: one integer atomic per diffusive face when explicitly enabled; default off; match profiling settings in comparisons
transport.slot_lifetime: FREE -> PACKING -> TRANSFER/event -> HOST_CONSUMING -> FREE; one stream, one owned pinned slot; no overlap claim
transport.blockThreads: elementwise kernels only; reduction kernels retain 256 threads

memory.poolScratchBytes: capacity times preallocated mass/state/drift/order/fixed error storage
memory.flowStagingBytes: actual vector capacities in Flow (reported separately)
memory.workerOwnedBytesKnown: sizeof(Model) times worker count, lower bound only
memory.hostSnapshotBytes: pre-Strang q and CellState snapshots remain alive; see report lifetime table
memory.pinnedBytes: actual CUDA pinned allocation, zero in CPU emulation
memory.deviceLiveBytes: Execution-owned CUDA allocations (CPU heap for backend=0), not device-process RSS
